Name: Vanilla Tips---Loading Screen Flavor Text
Author: neoiw
Description:
[size=6][b]Vanilla Tips ---(Open-Sourced 开源项目) [/b][/size]

You can't rush these secrets. You can only sleep on them.

Vanilla Tips is my love letter to the hidden depth of vanilla Stardew Valley: 167 mechanics the game never explains — subtle enough that most players miss them forever, useful enough that knowing them changes how your farm grows. It adds no items, changes no formulas, and never interrupts you. It simply tells you what the game was already doing all along, one short line at a time — on the sleep black screen, at the exact moment your day ends.

[b]What you'll learn while you sleep:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]167 tips, every single one fact-checked against the official wiki[/b] before shipping[/*]
[*][b]Five progress stages[/b] (early / mid / late / endgame / general): a Spring Year-1 farmer never gets endgame spoilers, and every stage can be toggled off[/*]
[*][b]Bilingual[/b] — Chinese and English ship together; tips follow your game language[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer-ready[/b]: the host rolls one tip and broadcasts it to every screen; if a peer has a source you don't, it falls back to a built-in tip — never a blank night[/*]
[*][b]Zero footprint[/b]: nothing is written to your save, so install or uninstall any time[/*]
[/list]
No pop-ups, no menus, no bloat — just the quiet joy of going "wait, it does WHAT?" once a night.

Open source under GPL-3.0. Download it, learn something tonight, tell a friend, fork it — and let these little secrets spread to every farm in the valley.



[line]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]167 vanilla-mechanics tips[/b] across 5 game stages — early / mid / late / endgame / general.[/*]
[*][b]Bilingual[/b]: every tip ships in Chinese and English; language follows your game language.[/*]
[*][b]Nightly or occasional[/b] frequency (about every night, or about half the nights).[/*]
[*][b]Fully configurable[/b] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]: master switch, frequency, per-stage toggles, and per-source weights (0 = off, max 50; the built-in pool is fixed at 50). Without GMCM, the same options are available in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].[/*]
[*][b]Write your own tips[/b] — drop a JSON file into [font=Courier New]Mods/VanillaTips/custom/[/font], type [font=Courier New]vt_reload[/font] in the SMAPI console, done. No programming required.[/*]
[*][b]Third-party mods can inject tips[/b] through a public SMAPI API (weights, stages, zh/en).[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer friendly[/b]: host-broadcast with deterministic fallback; split-screen supported.[/*]
[*][b]Gets out of your way[/b]: uninstall or remove the mod and there is no leftover state in your saves.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Uninstall[/b][/size]

Delete the [font=Courier New]VanillaTips[/font] folder from [font=Courier New]Mods/[/font]. If you had custom tips you want to keep, copy the [font=Courier New]custom[/font] folder somewhere first. The mod doesn't store anything in your save.

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed, open the in-game settings for "Vanilla Tips":

[list]
[*][b]Enable night tips[/b] — master switch.[/*]
[*][b]Frequency[/b] — every night, or about half the nights.[/*]
[*][b]Progress categories[/b] — check / uncheck each stage (early/mid/late/endgame/general).[/*]
[*][b]Tip sources[/b] — built-in pool is fixed at 50; every other registered source (for example tips injected by another mod) can be set 0–50, where 0 disables that source.[/*]
[/list]
Without GMCM, edit [font=Courier New]Mods/VanillaTips/config.json[/font] with the same options.

[size=5][b]Writing your own tips (no coding)[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Open [font=Courier New]Mods/VanillaTips/custom/[/font] and copy [font=Courier New]示例.json[/font] to a new file (e.g. [font=Courier New]my-tips.json[/font]).[/*]
[*]Format (see the shipped example):[/*]
[/list]
[code]
{
  "tips": [
    {
      "id": "my-1",
      "category": "early",
      "texts": {
        "zh": "你的提示文本。",
        "en": "Your tip text in English."
      }
    }
  ]
}[/code]
[list=1]
[*]In the SMAPI console, type [font=Courier New]vt_reload[/font] to apply without restarting.[/*]
[*]Type [font=Courier New]vt_list[/font] to see all loaded sources and tip counts. A malformed file reports its path.[/*]
[/list]
Your custom tips join the built-in pool with the same fixed weight (50).

[size=5][b]Third-party mod API[/b][/size]

[code]
var api = Helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<IVanillaTipsApi>("neoiw.vanillatips");
api?.RegisterTips("my_mod_id", 50f, ids, categories, zhTexts, enTexts);[/code]
Any source id is allowed (only [font=Courier New]builtin[/font] is reserved). Registering the same source id again replaces that source; [font=Courier New]RemoveTips[/font] removes tips. Weight is per source (0–50, default on first register, player-adjustable in GMCM). In multiplayer, every machine needs the same third-party mods.

[size=5][b]SMAPI console commands[/b][/size]


[table][tr][td][b]Command[/b][/td]
[td][b]Purpose[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]vt_reload[/font][/td]
[td]Reload built-in / custom / content-pack tips[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]vt_list[/font][/td]
[td]List every source (name, count, weight, locked)[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]vt_pick <sourceId/tipId>[/font][/td]
[td]Force-show a specific tip next night (testing)[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 / SMAPI 4.0+.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer + local split-screen supported.[/*]
[*]Coexists with Growing Children Expanded: if GCE is installed, GCE turns its own tips off and routes its 46 tips through Vanilla Tips (source [font=Courier New]gce[/font], adjustable weight).[/*]
[*]No save edits; safe to add or remove any time.[/*]
[/list]

[url=https://github.com/neoiw0/StardewVanillaTips][/url]
[line]
[url=https://github.com/neoiw0/StardewVanillaTips][/url]
[size=6][b]Vanilla Tips（原生机制夜晚小提示）[/b][/size]

有些秘密急不来——只能睡一觉，等它自己来。

Vanilla Tips 是我写给原版星露谷的一封情书：167 条游戏从不解释的隐藏机制，隐蔽到多数玩家一辈子都发现不了，又实用到知道的那一刻就会改变你种田的方式。它不加一件物品、不改一个公式、也绝不打断你的游戏——只是每天结束的那一瞬间，在换日黑屏上轻轻告诉你：这个游戏一直在偷偷为你做些什么。

[b]睡着睡着，你就学会了：[/b]

[list]
[*][b]167 条提示，发布前每一条都对照官方维基逐条核实[/b][/*]
[*][b]五个进度阶段[/b]（早期/中期/后期/极后期/通用）：春 Y1 的新手永远不会刷到后期剧透，每个阶段也都能单独关掉[/*]
[*][b]中英双语[/b]：每条提示中文英文同时随包，跟随游戏语言显示[/*]
[*][b]多人就绪[/b]：主机每晚抽一条广播到每个屏幕；对方装了本机没有的来源时自动退回内置池兜底，绝无一整夜空屏[/*]
[*][b]零痕迹[/b]：不向存档写入任何数据，随时装、随时卸[/*]
[/list]
没有弹窗轰炸，没有多余界面——只有每晚一句"等等，它居然是这样？"的小惊喜。

开源、GPL-3.0：下载它，今晚就学一手，告诉朋友，Fork 它——让这些小秘密传遍山谷里的每一座农场。



[line]

[size=5][b]功能[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]167 条原生机制提示[/b]，按 5 个进度阶段划分：早期 / 中期 / 后期 / 极后期 / 通用。[/*]
[*][b]中英双语[/b]：每条提示同时带中文与英文，跟随游戏语言显示。[/*]
[*][b]频率可选[/b]：每晚显示，或约一半的夜晚显示。[/*]
[*][b]完全可配置[/b]：装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]（可选）后可在游戏内设置总开关、频率、按阶段勾选、按来源调权重（0=关闭，最高 50；内置池固定 50）。没装 GMCM 也能改 [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]。[/*]
[*][b]自己写提示[/b]：往 [font=Courier New]Mods/VanillaTips/custom/[/font] 丢一个 JSON 文件，在 SMAPI 控制台输入 [font=Courier New]vt_reload[/font] 立即生效——不用写代码。[/*]
[*][b]第三方模组可注入提示[/b]：通过公开的 SMAPI API（权重、阶段、中英文本）。[/*]
[*][b]多人友好[/b]：主机抽选广播 + 确定性兜底；支持本机分屏。[/*]
[*][b]不打扰存档[/b]：卸载或移除本模组，存档里不残留任何状态。[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]卸载[/b][/size]

删除 [font=Courier New]Mods/VanillaTips[/font] 文件夹即可。若保留自定义提示，先复制 [font=Courier New]custom[/font] 目录。本模组不向存档写入任何数据。

[size=5][b]配置[/b][/size]

装了 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 后，在游戏内设置找到「Vanilla Tips」：

[list]
[*]启用夜晚小提示（总开关）；频率（每晚/约半数夜晚）；进度分类（按阶段勾选）；[/*]
[*]提示来源：内置池固定 50；其他来源（如其他模组注入的提示）可设 0–50，0=关闭。[/*]
[/list]
没装 GMCM 时，同样选项在 [font=Courier New]Mods/VanillaTips/config.json[/font] 中修改。

[size=5][b]增加Vanilla Tips·手写提示（无需编程）[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]打开 [font=Courier New]Mods/VanillaTips/custom/[/font]，复制 [font=Courier New]示例.json[/font] 改名（如 [font=Courier New]我的提示.json[/font]）。[/*]
[*]按格式编写（见随包示例）。[/*]
[/list]
[code]
{
  "tips": [
    {
      "id": "my-1",
      "category": "early",
      "texts": {
        "zh": "你的提示文本。",
        "en": "Your tip text in English."
      }
    }
  ]
}[/code]
[list=1]
[*]SMAPI 控制台输入 [font=Courier New]vt_reload[/font] 立即生效；[font=Courier New]vt_list[/font] 查看来源与条数。[/*]
[/list]
自定义提示并入内置池，权重固定 50。

[size=5][b]第三方模组 API[/b][/size]

[code]
var api = Helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<IVanillaTipsApi>("neoiw.vanillatips");
api?.RegisterTips("my_mod_id", 50f, ids, categories, zhTexts, enTexts);[/code]
除 [font=Courier New]builtin[/font] 为保留名外，任何来源名都可注册；同名重复注册=整体覆盖，[font=Courier New]RemoveTips[/font] 可移除。权重为来源级（0–50，首次注册值为默认，GMCM 可调）。

[size=5][b]SMAPI 指令[/b][/size]


[table][tr][td][b]指令[/b][/td]
[td][b]作用[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]vt_reload[/font][/td]
[td]热重载内置/自定义/内容包提示[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]vt_list[/font][/td]
[td]列出全部来源（名称/条数/权重/锁定）[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]vt_pick <sourceId/tipId>[/font][/td]
[td]指定下一条显示的提示（测试用）[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[size=5][b]兼容性[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 / SMAPI 4.0+；支持多人与本机分屏。[/*]
[*]与 Growing Children Expanded 共存：装有 GCE 时，GCE 自动关闭自身提示，并把它的 46 条经本模组注入（来源 [font=Courier New]gce[/font]，权重可调）。[/*]
[*]不改存档；随时可装可卸。[/*]
[/list]
